comment: * A builder class for constructing {@link WebViewAssetLoader} objects.

variables.name: mHandlerList
variables.comment: permit multiple PathHandlers for the same path.

methods.name: public Builder setDomain(@NonNull String domain)
methods.comment:
* Set the domain under which app assets can be accessed.
         * The default domain is {@code "appassets.androidplatform.net"}
         *
         * @param domain the domain on which app assets should be hosted.
         * @return {@link Builder} object.

methods.name: public Builder setHttpAllowed(boolean httpAllowed)
methods.comment:
* Allow using the HTTP scheme in addition to HTTPS.
         * The default is to not allow HTTP.
         *
         * @return {@link Builder} object.

methods.name: public Builder addPathHandler(@NonNull String path, @NonNull PathHandler handler)
methods.comment:
* Register a {@link PathHandler} for a specific path. *

* The path should start and end with a {@code "/"} and it shouldn't collide with a real web * path. * *

{@code WebViewAssetLoader} will try {@code PathHandlers} in the order they're * registered, and will use whichever is the first to return a non-{@code null} {@link * WebResourceResponse}. * * @param path the prefix path where this handler should be register. * @param handler {@link PathHandler} that handles requests for this path. * @return {@link Builder} object. * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the path is invalid.

methods.name: public WebViewAssetLoader build()
methods.comment:
* Build and return a {@link WebViewAssetLoader} object.
         *
         * @return immutable {@link WebViewAssetLoader} object.

methodNames: public Builder addPathHandler(@NonNull String path, @NonNull PathHandler handler)
